page.overview:
Who is Banana Fairy Princess?

The Banana Fairy Princess can be found inside of Banana Fairy Island that only Tiny Kong can enter with her Mini-Monkey ability. The Princess is seen crying over the loss of the Banana Fairies due to King K. Rool's appearance on the island. Tiny agrees to help her and the Banana Fairy Princess gives Tiny a special camera and film in order to capture the Banana Fairies in. Also, the Princess gives Tiny a special shockwave techique that can take down most enemies in one hit including Kasplats.
